description: Every talk on one day with its time (Mountain), room, the concepts it assumes and assumes_status. A talk is ready when the student knows every concept it assumes; a talk with assumes_status 'tagged' and no concepts is ready for everyone. If assumes_status is not 'tagged', we don't know yet what the talk assumes, so say that.

configuration.query: FROM sessions | WHERE is_talk == true AND DATE_FORMAT("yyyy-MM-dd", day) == ?day | EVAL local = starts_at - 7 hours, time = DATE_FORMAT("EEE HH:mm", local) | SORT local | KEEP title, time, room, assumes, assumes_status | LIMIT 200

day.description: The day as YYYY-MM-DD. KubeCon talks run 2026-11-09 (Mon) to 2026-11-12 (Thu).
